title: Common
description: Shared closed vocabularies, identifier and hash formats, and reusable sub-schemas for Veyltrace contracts v0.1. Not an artifact; contract schemas reference it as common.schema.json#/$defs/<def>.

family.description: Signal family of a series (03 §1); used by signal_cube.series and anomalies.

klass.description: Signal class of a series (03 §1); used by signal_cube.series and anomalies.

mode.description: Fault mode of a candidate (03 §1); used by slate, verdict and answer_key.

fault_class.description: Fault class (03 §1); socket = RCAEval RE2 socket exhaustion, availability = pod kill, container restart or pod failure.

source.description: Telemetry source, full set including events (03 §1); e.g. alignment.offsets[].source.

event_kind.description: Kind of a change event (03 §1); used by telemetry.events and changes.

verdict_status.description: Verdict status (03 §1 'status'); used by verdict, card and bench_result.

window.description: Window of an evidence atom (03 §7): baseline, incident or onset.

cube_window.description: Aggregation window of signal_cube.edges and signal_cube.critical_path (03 §3.2, §3.4): baseline or incident only.

confidence_level.description: Verdict confidence level (03 §10): CONFIRMED -> high, LIKELY -> medium, INCONCLUSIVE with a leader -> low, else none.

trial_id.description: Verification trial id, T1..T10 in numeric order (03 §9.1, §10).

trial_result.description: Outcome of one verification trial (03 §10 ranked[].trials[].result).

ai_mode.description: AI execution mode ai.mode (contract_changes A8); part of the run_id preimage.

ai_arm.description: AI experiment arm (contract_changes A8); used by calibration and bench.

alert_protocol.description: Alert protocol (03 §2.6); used by alert, calibration and bench_result.

hint_source.description: Origin of case_manifest.t_alert_hint_ns (03 §2.1); none if and only if the hint is null.

predicate.description: Claim-check predicate library v0.1 (03 §7); used by evidence and proposals.

atom_kind.description: Evidence atom kind (03 §7); intervention = Causalith's restricted conditional-independence test for trial T8.

rejection_reason.description: Why a proposal was rejected (03 §10 proposals_rejected[].reason).

indicator.description: Root indicator from Causatrix's indicator_map (contract_changes A7); family other maps to unknown.

span_kind.description: Span kind (03 §2.4); Infralume fills unspecified when the source has none.

system.description: Benchmark system of a case (03 §2.1); live is a dataset, not a system.

telemetry_source_subset.description: Telemetry source without events (03 §3.1, §4.1, §4.2): metrics, logs or traces.

ask_kind.description: Kind of a request for more information (03 §9.1 asks[].kind; contract_changes B verdict.asks).

provenance.description: Evidence source of a dependency-graph node or edge (03 §6.1, §6.2).

case_id.description: Case id: first 12 hex of SHA-256 of the adapter's canonical case key (03 §1, contract_changes B).

run_id.description: Run id: first 16 hex of SHA-256(case_id, config_sha256, code_commit, ai.mode), plus -x<12 hex> for a derived verify_hypothesis run (02 §4.1, contract_changes A6).

atom_id.description: Evidence atom id: E + first 10 hex of SHA-256 of [kind, candidate, canonical args] (03 §1, contract_changes B).

change_id.description: Change id: C + first 10 hex of SHA-256 of the change row preimage (03 §5.2, contract_changes B).

template_id.description: Log template id: T + first 8 hex of SHA-256(service, template) (03 §3.3).

proposal_id.description: Proposal id: P + 8 hex (contract_changes B proposals); used by proposals and verdict.

series_id.description: Series id {service}|{component}|{signal}|{source}; each part is non-empty and contains no | (03 §3.1, contract_changes B).

service_name.description: Normalised service, component, entity or node name: lowercase, no underscore (contract_changes A6).

dataset.description: Dataset name such as synth, re2-ob or veyllab-otel (contract_changes A6); a pattern, not an enum.

semver_0_1.description: Contract version string for v0.1, as carried in schema_version (CONVENTIONS §3.6).

Sources.description: Per-source presence switches; shared by case_manifest.sources and Causatrix's Sources type (contract_changes B).

TimeWindow.description: Half-open window [start_ns, end_ns) of two int64 ns timestamps; start <= end is a writer check, contiguous windows allowed (contract_changes B alert.windows).
